description: Ask this site to read and check the declaration file a domain publishes at https://<domain>/.well-known/whoreadsthe.json, which declares the AI agents or crawlers the domain operates. Accepted agents get a record on this site. The file format is described at https://whoreadsthe.com/declare. At most 5 calls a minute per address.

domain.description: The registrable domain that publishes the declaration file, such as example.com.

name: submit_declaration
title: Declare an agent
